name: Task List
description: The main screen where the user sees all tasks in a table, searches, filters by status, and performs quick actions like marking done, editing, or deleting tasks.
entry_points: Redirect after creating a new task
information_displayed: Task due date (formatted as readable date)
Action buttons per row (Edit, Delete, Mark Done/Undo Done)

available_actions.description: Navigate to the Add/Edit Task form to create a new task
Filter tasks by typing in the search bar
Show only Pending, Done, or All tasks
Check off a task as completed
Mark a completed task back as pending
Navigate to the Add/Edit Task form

business_rules: 'Add Task' button must always be visible regardless of whether tasks exist
Tasks sorted by due date ascending by default (most urgent first)
Overdue tasks (past due date and not done) should be visually highlighted
Completed tasks should have distinct styling (e.g., strikethrough on title)
Deleting a task is immediate — no confirmation dialog needed
edge_cases: No tasks yet — show friendly empty state message with 'Add Task' button
All tasks completed — show encouraging message
Search/filter returns zero results — show 'No matching tasks' message
Task with no due date — shown after dated tasks
open_questions: Should 'Mark task done' be a checkbox on the list, or only via edit form?
Maximum expected task count — affects pagination needs
